SELECT IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00')) = DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+09:00')) THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END ),0) AS todaySales, COUNT( CASE WHEN DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00')) = DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+09:00')) THEN o.order_id END ) AS todayOrders,
IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT( CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+09:00'), '%Y-%m' ) THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END ),0) AS monthlySales,
IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00')) = DATE_SUB( DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+09:00')), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END ),0) AS yesterdaySales,
IFNULL(AVG(o.total_price),0) AS averageOrderPrice, COUNT(o.order_id) AS completedOrders FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('완료','COMPLETED')

SELECT m.menu_name AS menuName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS orderCount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN menus m ON oi.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('완료','COMPLETED') GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.menu_name ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00')) AS salesDate, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orderCount, SUM(o.total_price) AS totalSales FROM orders o WHERE CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') >= DATE_SUB( DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+09:00')), INTERVAL 29 DAY ) AND o.order_status IN ('완료','COMPLETED') GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00')) ORDER BY salesDate desc

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS totalSales, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(AVG(o.total_price), 0) AS averageOrderPrice FROM orders o WHERE CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') >= #{startDate} AND CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') < #{endDateExclusive} AND o.order_status IN ('완료','COMPLETED')

SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00')) AS salesDate, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS totalSales FROM orders o WHERE CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') >= #{startDate} AND CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') < #{endDateExclusive} AND o.order_status IN ('완료','COMPLETED') GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00')) ORDER BY salesDate DESC

SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.menu_name AS menuName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, IFNULL(SUM(oi.price_at_order * oi.quantity), 0) AS totalSales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN menus m ON oi.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') >= #{startDate} AND CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') < #{endDateExclusive} AND o.order_status IN ('완료','COMPLETED') GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.menu_name ORDER BY totalSales DESC, quantity DESC, m.menu_id

SELECT p.payment_method AS paymentMethod, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS totalSales FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.payment_status = '성공' WHERE CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') >= #{startDate} AND CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, @@session.time_zone, '+09:00') < #{endDateExclusive} AND o.order_status IN ('완료','COMPLETED') GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY totalSales DESC, p.payment_method
